data_description.connection_mode:
• Cloud Only (Recommended for stability): Periodic polling every 10-30s. Highest 24/7 reliability, completely prevents internal microcontroller UART buffer overruns and station lockups. Ideal if you experience freezes or telemetry loss.
• Automatic: Real-time local streaming (1s) with seamless cloud fallback if local connection drops.
• LAN Only: Direct local real-time push (1s) with zero cloud requests (warning: per vendor firmware design, the station still requires internet access to emit telemetry and is prone to UART freezes on network jitter).
data_description.host: Optional: leave empty for automatic network discovery. Recommended if your station has a static IP to improve and accelerate connection.
data_description.auth_key: AES encryption key for local LAN sessions. Automatically retrieved from cloud and persisted across restarts, but can be manually entered for offline operation.
data_description.poll_interval: Cloud polling frequency in seconds (10s recommended for high responsiveness, 15-30s for low bandwidth). In Cloud Only mode, 10s provides fresh data without overloading the hardware.
data_description.price_sensor: Optional: sensor providing current electricity price (e.g. PVPC or Nord Pool).
data_description.fixed_price: Fixed price per kWh used when no dynamic sensor is configured.
